ns2:course.label: Graphics for Architects
ns2:course.description: Introduction to architectural graphic communication skills that architects use to visualize, analyze, and record creative thoughts: 1) freehand sketching; 2) architectural delineation; and 3) digital applications. Prerequisite: ARCH 101 and concurrent enrollment in ARCH 231.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ARCH 101 and concurrent enrollment in ARCH 231.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Architectural Studies or Architecture major(s).
